# MODULUX — Folding Homes, Containers & Space Capsules | Cape Town, South Africa

> MODULUX builds double-wing folding homes, container units, and space capsules in Cape Town and delivers nationwide. From R25,000. NHBRC registered. Display Village in Bellville, Western Cape.
